integrity: Exact standalone integer verifier constructs the 735-state Boolean-relation automaton, establishes a 735-component vector recurrence identity, matches 40 formal generating-function coefficients, and independently enumerates forward images for all ring lengths 1 through 14. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts distinct one-step images on indexed finite periodic binary rings, not predecessor multiplicities or multi-step reachable sets.
The general Boolean-relation method is classical; originality concerns the specific Rule-73 all-length rational expression and complete finite certificate.
No dominant-pole root-isolation theorem or certified numerical entropy is included.
Earlier non-digitally indexed literature and finite-basin monographs may still contain equivalent identities.
title: An exact all-length cyclic image enumerator for elementary Rule 73
